## Appearance

Agatha Sowerby is a stout woman who weighs two hundred pounds, possessing a heavy body that gives her a perpetual waddling gait. She also has gentle, aged arms.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. ## Personality

Agatha Sowerby is a pious, cheerful, and industrious woman who exhibits a kind and compassionate nature alongside a motherly, gentle demeanor. She is notable for her candid, talkative, and opinionated personality, taking pride in voicing her opinions freely and holding firm, durable views on many subjects. While she acts as a dedicated caregiver and generous neighbor, she can also be severe, meddlesome, and critical of others. She harbors specific personal biases, such as opposing higher education for women, disdaining [Yankees](../codex/factions.md#yankee), and strictly opposing activities like drama and horse racing on moral grounds. Her habits include dressmaking, which she enjoys, and boasting about her homemade raspberry cordial. Additionally, she holds a strong personal preference regarding romantic outcomes, having wished that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) had chosen to marry [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md).

## History

Agatha Sowerby was raised on St. Brendan's [Island](../codex/places.md#brendan-s-island) and married by the age of eighteen, with a husband who was once cheated out of ten dollars by a [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) employer. She raised ten children through school, losing two in their youth, and went to school alongside a red-haired girl. Upon hearing that [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) intended to adopt an orphan from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), she visited [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to express her strong doubts and warn [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). Agatha later visited [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and mocked the plain appearance and red hair of the adopted girl, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), provoking a violent outburst; however, she forgave [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) when the girl delivered a humble apology. After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) smashed a slate over a classmate's head, Agatha advised [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to let her rest at home until her temper subsided. Later, Agatha assisted [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) in purchasing fabric and sewing a gown with puffed sleeves for [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Over time, her initial misgivings faded, and she commended Nell's growth, later congratulating her when she tied for the top score on the entrance exam. Following her husband Thomas's death, Agatha moved into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) so [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) could attend [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). While living at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), she helped raise the young twins [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), frequently handling Robin's misbehavior and strict discipline while keeping up correspondence with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Years later, Agatha joined [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) in preparing gifts and making guest lists for Nell's wedding to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), and she subsequently attended a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner hosted by the newlyweds at [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls).

## Quotes

> "However, I had a bit of a scare that you might not be, seeing Obed head out earlier today. My thought was that perhaps he was heading to the doctor’s office."
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014)

> "I simply reckon she has succeeded, and I would certainly not hold back from stating as much. You bring honor to your companions, Nell, indeed you do, and every one of us is proud of you."
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "I’m not aware of it. My assumption is that your teaching will take place directly here in Brierley. You have been selected by the trustees to receive the school."
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036)

> "While I was returning from Delford today, Mr. Pettifer was seen by me driving your Jersey from his oats. It appeared to me that he was quite furious. Was a big fuss made by him?"
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "That is the truth, I had not seen her appear so agreeable previously. Ah, over that poor old woman, not many tears were wept. To be free of her brings gratitude to the Elisha Ducketts, and I am unable to say that I fault them in the least."
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v3 ch.Evening P11](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0011)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--nell-harcourt.md)

Agatha initially antagonized [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by rudely mocking her red hair and plain appearance during a visit to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), prompting a fiery outburst from the girl. However, after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was persuaded to deliver a humble, dramatic apology at Agatha's home, Agatha forgave her and offered encouraging words about her hair, ending their brief enmity. She later provided helpful counsel regarding Nell's temper, advising [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to let the girl rest at home following a schoolhouse incident.

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--thirza-abernethy.md)

Agatha is a longstanding friend, neighbor, and traveling companion to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). Their bond involves frequent visits where Agatha offers advice and candid opinions, such as expressing early doubts about adopting an orphan or recommending how to handle Nell's temper after a school incident. Following the death of Agatha's husband, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) proposed inviting the widowed Agatha to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters).
